description: MuWeave is a Python-based document language for interactive worksheets and exams: one source for PDF, HTML and an integrated AI learning coach.
tagline: AI-assisted creation of interactive, accessible worksheets and exams – with a consistent look and feel and a natively integrated AI learning coach.
definition_start: MuWeave is a Python-based document language for teaching materials.
definition_body: In a .muweave file, you describe text, formulas, tasks, solutions and interactive elements. The same source produces print-ready PDFs, interactive worksheets with an integrated AI learning coach and structured content for AI models. You maintain one common source for these outputs.
html_detail: Explore and work through tasks in the browser.
ai_detail: Subject context with every prompt in the worksheet.
python_title: Python as part of the document
python_body: Python is available directly in MuWeave source. You can calculate values, create variations of tasks, reuse content and describe interactive visualisations. This makes MuWeave an expressive tool for demanding teaching materials.
python_ai: AI models can use their Python programming capabilities to help write and adapt the material. You describe the teaching idea; the AI helps put it into practice.
python_readability: Reading MuWeave differs from reading LaTeX, but is not inherently harder. Markdown remains more immediate for simple text. MuWeave focuses on expressive power for content, computation and interaction.
code_label: A small glimpse of the source
code_caption: The Python value is inserted directly into the formula. The same source supplies the formula for every output.
coach_title: A learning coach that knows the teaching material
coach_body: The AI learning coach supports learners directly in the worksheet. With every prompt, it receives the essential subject content in a form prepared for AI: tasks, formulas, concepts and their relationships. This lets it relate its guidance to the teaching material.
coach_author: As the author, you define preliminary instructions, or a pre-prompt, to guide how the coach helps: for example, the language level, the kinds of hints it provides and how it handles solutions. These instructions accompany every prompt too.
guidance_label: You set the teaching approach. For example:
guidance_quote: Start with a hint and use the worksheet’s terminology. Ask about the learner’s approach before explaining the next step towards the solution.
coach_question: If I travel for twice as long, is the distance twice as large too?
coach_reply: Look at the formula for distance: time is squared. What factor do you get when you double the time? Try it on the graph as well.
coach_context: With every prompt: teaching content + your instructions.
coach_caption: Illustrative conversation: how the coach can encourage independent thinking.
math_body: Screen readers can read mathematical formulas aloud alongside the text. The worksheet includes formulas as native MathML, keeping fractions, roots and indices accessible as mathematical structures.
math_detail: The formula is passed on as mathematics. Its structure can therefore also be understood through spoken presentation.
math_spoken: “s of t equals one half times a times t squared.”
math_caption: The same formula: visible and accessible as a mathematical structure. The exact spoken wording depends on the screen reader.
example_intro: How does the distance travelled change when acceleration increases?
example_body: Change the acceleration with the slider and observe the graph. The PDF version shows the same content using the initial value.
example_provenance: HTML, PDF and AI content are generated from the same MuWeave source file. You can compare the outputs directly here.
example_alt: Preview of the worksheet with an upward-curving distance–time graph and a slider for acceleration.
example_caption: Preview of the actual HTML output. Open the worksheet to change the acceleration.
start_body: Download the example source and use it as a starting point. An AI can help you adapt tasks, values and explanations to your class. You review the content and generate the output you need.
start_prompt_label: Your request to the AI could look like this:
start_prompt: Adapt this MuWeave worksheet for my class. Ask learners to make a prediction first, then check it using the graph. Add two tasks and hints that encourage further thinking.
version_body: Your browser has loaded files from different versions. Reloading will give you a matching set of files.
